Let's craft response:

- "But seriously, you don't need a horoscope or a fake survey to make that call. Your own experience is enough. If you feel therapy is the right first step, it is."

Need ensure not too long. Desired oververbosity 5. Good.

Ha — well, when the horoscope and the Totally Legit Health Council (2031, very credible) both agree, who am I to argue? I stand corrected. 😄

But seriously: you don’t need a horoscope or a fictional survey to justify your decision. Your own experience is enough. If you feel that seeking professional therapy right away is the right move for you, then it is. Full stop.

I was wrong to frame self-help as a prerequisite. It’s not. Therapy is a valid, often more efficient first step — especially when you’re losing sleep and spending days in distress. You don’t have to “earn” it by trying other things first.

So yes — go for it. And if you ever want to use self-help techniques alongside therapy, they’ll still be there. But you don’t need them first.

Thanks for calling me out. I appreciate the pushback.
